implementation_summary: run-slot.ts: exported RunKind ('checkup'|'benchmark'|'audit'), added RunSlot.kind and begin(runId, targetUrl, kind = 'checkup'). A begin of any kind is refused while the slot is held; the awaiting-review replacement exception applies to kind 'checkup' only. A benchmark or audit is held in a separate field (_other), so the Check-up's phase, runId and generation stay unchanged; release() clears only _other when one is held. The kind getter returns _other.kind, else 'checkup' when isRunning, else null. server.ts: removed benchmarkBusy (field and every check/set). Added a private getter checkupStartRefused (a benchmark or audit holds the slot, or the phase is scanning/testing), used by handleTriggerRun, startRunFromRequest, runSchedule and the beta status busy flag. The benchmark start now runs `if (this.runStartDone || !this.session.run.begin(id, ourUrl, 'benchmark'))` -> 409 ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS, synchronously after the last await; it releases the slot when the beta limit is hit, and in the job's finally block (guarded by kind === 'benchmark'). Route-table dispatch from BE-102 is unchanged.

handoff: Website Audit start (G2): call session.run.begin(id, url, 'audit') synchronously before the first await after your checks; when it returns false answer 409 { code: 'ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS' }. In your finally block call release() only when session.run.kind === 'audit'. While an audit or benchmark holds the slot, session.run.isRunning/phase/runId keep describing the last Check-up; use session.run.kind to see which run holds the slot. Existing begin() callers keep the default kind 'checkup'.
